parameters: inputs.schema.json: every null blocks; no backend or workload resources are selected here

tenantKeyStore.purpose: Separate physical persisted state and snapshot domain for tenant keys

snapshotBoundary.reason: A KV mount or path cannot filter the persisted state of a whole-instance snapshot; distinct membership must follow from the selected backend and separate physical state.

perAppComponentProposal.description: Repeat only for owner-supplied apps; symbolic metadata, no Kubernetes resource emitted

caCert.meaning: Selected mounted public-CA file path goes into caCert; source, directory mount and readable file mapping require owner evidence.

caPem.meaning: Selected inline public-CA mapping goes into caPem; no CA bytes are supplied or rendered here.

caDeliveryContract.meaning: The delivery mode, source, paths and mapping remain unknown. TLS verifies the selected server name and CA; skipVerify is false.

perPodMountProposal.bootstrapException: Named per-app token bootstrap Secret; secret values remain outside this package and rendered application charts

annotation.name: dapr.io/volume-mounts
annotation.binding: Selected volumeName:mountDirectory pair; verify pinned injector semantics and actual read-only sidecar directory mount, projected key mapping and full token file path before live acceptance

perPodMountProposal.qualificationRequired: Restricted Pod Security, no excessive capabilities, readable only by intended runtime, no broad RBAC or cross-app token access
perPodMountProposal.filePathInvariant: vaultTokenMountPath equals mountDirectory/projectedFileName; directory mount and token file path are separate parameters
perPodMountProposal.bootstrapSecretRefGrammar: Unqualified Secret DNS-subdomain name only; projected sourceKey is a separate parameter.

ownership.storeComponentPoliciesAndNamedBootstrapS: Environment-layer identity; exact principal remains null in inputs
ownership.dynamicNamespaceWriter: Sole owning app declared in the future secret contract; no identity selected
ownership.unsealAndRecovery: Administrator and independently equipped recovery deputy, manually within declared coverage
ownership.tokenRenewal: Named per-app owner outside Dapr; exact identities, lifecycle and monitoring remain null
ownership.rotationRestartAndRevocation: Named restart owner coordinates issuer and app owner; exact identities remain null

rotationSequence: Verify owner approval, current contract and issuer metadata; retain least-privilege scope and expand-only required generations.
Issuer owner prepares a separate per-app replacement and delivers it through the selected per-pod bootstrap reference without exposing bytes in evidence.
Restart each affected pod and its Dapr sidecar after delivery; a mounted file update alone cannot reload a running sidecar.
Bind observations to staging, app ID, exact contract digest, required token delivery revision and exact required secret generations; record new pod identity and sidecar-after-delivery acknowledgment.
Platform and the named owner acknowledge every affected pod; otherwise keep readiness refused and stop the cutover.
Only after full acknowledgment may the separately authorized issuer owner revoke the old per-app or shared token; prove old access denied, retain expiry/renewal monitoring.

proposedReadinessContract.description: prepare.py checks supplied metadata consistency only; no observation authentication, restart/new-pod proof, all-replica coverage, deployed readiness or live acceptance
binds: each logical secret ID and exact required generation
new pod identity and sidecar-start-after-delivery acknowledgment
refuses: unacknowledged rotation or stale delivery revision
proposedReadinessContract.scope: Exactly one supplied pod observation per app, with distinct podUid values across apps. metadataReady cannot establish complete expected pod inventory or all-replica acknowledgment.
